category_rationales.architecture: Strict acyclic 4-layer Clean Architecture (api -> services -> domain/infra) with 0 circular dependencies, pure framework-free domain models/pricing, OrderRepository Protocol port, and FastAPI async lifespan DI; minor opportunity to pool httpx.AsyncClient across lifespan and add durable repository adapters.
category_rationales.code_quality: 100.0% import hygiene, 0 complex functions, 0 excessive parameters, 0 global mutable state, 0 bug-risk idioms, and bounded 5.0s webhook timeouts with graceful WEBHOOK_DEFERRED degradation across 435 LOC.
category_rationales.typing: 100.0% parameter and return type coverage across 23 functions and 14 classes, PEP 561 py.typed marker, frozen dataclasses, StrEnum, and zero Any or unscoped ignores; CI lacks a 'uv run ty check' step.
category_rationales.testing: 4/4 pytest tests pass offline (--network=none) and FastAPI /healthz boots cleanly (HTTP 200) with 85.2% aggregate line coverage, but branch coverage is 62.5% due to untested HTTP handlers in routes.py (56.0%), webhook_client.py (55.6%), and main.py lifespan (67.9%).
category_rationales.dependencies: Clean PEP 621 pyproject.toml, SHA-pinned CI actions with read-only permissions, and weekly Dependabot across uv/docker/github-actions, tempered by an incomplete uv.lock missing transitive package pins and pip install in Dockerfile.
category_rationales.security: Application runtime dependencies (fastapi, httpx, pydantic, uvicorn) have 0 CVEs, 0 secrets, and 0 CWE dangerous sinks under non-root UID 10001, and live containerized DAST (.pni/pentests/, 15/19 passed, 0 CRITICAL/HIGH) empirically verified Pydantic extra='forbid' mass-assignment rejection (HTTP 422) and XSS/SQLi/traversal resilience; deductions reflect 9 CRITICAL / 116 HIGH Debian 12.7 OS CVEs and 5 MEDIUM pip@24.2 CVEs in python:3.12.6-slim-bookworm plus live-confirmed unauthenticated POST /v1/orders (HTTP 201, CWE-306), public /openapi.json exposure (CWE-200), and missing X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header (CWE-693).
category_rationales.documentation: 100.0% Google-style docstring coverage with zero signature mismatches plus Diataxis-aligned README and SECURITY.md, missing only developer test/lint commands and ORDER_DISPATCH_VIP_DISCOUNT_RATE.

structure_map.boundary_assessment: Internal import graph is a strict Directed Acyclic Graph (0 circular dependencies, 0 boundary violations). Domain modules (models.py, pricing.py) have zero dependencies on FastAPI, Pydantic, or httpx, and API routes never touch InMemoryOrderRepository or AsyncWebhookClient directly.

execution_flows.name: Order Creation, Pricing, Persistence & Async Webhook Dispatch
execution_flows.trigger: HTTP POST /v1/orders with JSON CreateOrderRequest payload
steps: 1. FastAPI validates JSON body via CreateOrderRequest & OrderLineInput (extra='forbid', SKU strip/uppercase) and resolves OrderDispatcherService via Depends(get_dispatcher).
2. create_order() maps OrderLineInput DTOs to immutable domain OrderLine tuples via to_domain_lines() and awaits dispatcher.place_order().
3. OrderDispatcherService computes integer-cents subtotal and VIP discount via compute_order_total_cents() and constructs an initial OrderRecord (status=ACCEPTED) with a ord-<hex> UUID.
4. AsyncWebhookClient.notify_order_accepted() sends a non-blocking httpx.AsyncClient POST with explicit timeout_sec (default 5.0s), returning True on 2xx or False on HTTPError.
5. OrderDispatcherService transitions OrderRecord status to DISPATCHED (2xx) or WEBHOOK_DEFERRED (failure), saves it in InMemoryOrderRepository, and routes.py returns HTTP 201 OrderResponse.

execution_flows.name: Order Lookup by Identifier
steps: 1. get_order() injects OrderDispatcherService from app.state via Depends(get_dispatcher).
2. dispatcher.find_order(order_id) queries OrderRepository.get(order_id) backed by InMemoryOrderRepository._records.
3. Raises HTTPException(404) when absent or projects OrderRecord to frozen OrderResponse DTO via to_order_response().

execution_flows.name: Application Startup Lifespan & Readiness Probe
steps: 1. create_app() loads ServiceSettings (ORDER_DISPATCH_* env vars) and registers @asynccontextmanager lifespan.
2. lifespan() initializes InMemoryOrderRepository, AsyncWebhookClient(endpoint_url, timeout_sec), and OrderDispatcherService onto app.state.
3. GET /healthz injects ServiceSettings via Depends(get_settings) and returns HealthResponse(service, environment, status='ok').

state_and_storage: FastAPI app.state holds singleton ServiceSettings and OrderDispatcherService initialized during async lifespan startup (src/order_dispatch/main.py).
InMemoryOrderRepository stores OrderRecord frozen dataclasses in process-local dict[str, OrderRecord] behind the OrderRepository typing.Protocol port (src/order_dispatch/infra/repository.py).
execution_flow_map.error_and_concurrency_model: Single-process asyncio event loop with zero blocking I/O inside async def handlers. Outbound webhook failures (httpx.HTTPError / timeouts) are caught in AsyncWebhookClient, logged as warnings, and gracefully degraded to OrderStatus.WEBHOOK_DEFERRED rather than failing the client order. Missing orders raise FastAPI HTTPException(404), and invalid request payloads return Pydantic HTTP 422 validation errors.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Supply-Chain CVEs, Container Misconfigs, Secrets, Dangerous Sinks & API Boundaries
audit_dimensions.summary: Trivy container & filesystem scanning alongside AST SAST confirms zero CRITICAL/HIGH vulnerabilities in Python application dependencies (fastapi, httpx, pydantic, uvicorn have 0 CVEs), zero leaked secrets, zero CWE dangerous code sinks, and non-root container execution (0 HIGH/CRITICAL IaC misconfigs, 1 LOW DS-0026 missing HEALTHCHECK). However, Dockerfile pins an older python:3.12.6-slim-bookworm (Debian 12.7) snapshot carrying 508 OS package CVEs (9 CRITICAL, 116 HIGH in openssl, libgnutls30, perl-base, zlib1g, libsqlite3-0) plus 6 pip@24.2 CVEs (5 MEDIUM, 1 LOW), and /v1/orders endpoints lack caller authentication (SEC-05).

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Test Suite Completeness & Structure
audit_dimensions.summary: The pytest suite (3 files, 4 test functions, zero assertion-free tests, 100% AST module import reachability) is deterministic and offline-safe via _StubWebhookClient, thoroughly testing domain pricing invariants and OrderDispatcherService state transitions. However, test_routes.py only checks route registration metadata without executing FastAPI lifespan or HTTP endpoints via TestClient/ASGITransport, and AsyncWebhookClient.notify_order_accepted() lacks httpx.MockTransport tests.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Live HTTP Penetration Findings, Security Headers & Endpoint Defenses
audit_dimensions.summary: Dynamic containerized HTTP penetration testing (.pni/pentests/examples/python/api_fastapi_clean against isolated loopback Uvicorn container, status='passed', 19 probes: 15 passed, 3 failed, 1 skipped, 0 CRITICAL/HIGH) empirically verified strong input and injection defenses—Pydantic ConfigDict(extra='forbid') rejected mass-assignment payloads (is_admin/total_cents) with HTTP 422, and all reflected XSS, SQLi/stacktrace, path traversal/LFI, CORS, TRACE, and sensitive-artifact (.env/.git) probes passed—while proving 3 live medium/low hardening gaps: unauthenticated POST /v1/orders order creation returning HTTP 201 (CWE-306), public /openapi.json exposure (CWE-200, 4,753 bytes), and missing X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header on /healthz (CWE-693).

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Buildability, Offline Test Results, Measured Coverage & Startup Health
audit_dimensions.summary: Containerized runtime verification succeeded across all execution stages: both the project Dockerfile (25.03s) and PNI uv harness (5.61s) built cleanly, 4/4 pytest unit tests passed offline under --network=none (4.60s), and FastAPI booted cleanly on GET /healthz -> HTTP 200 (2.67s). Aggregate line coverage is 85.2% (178/209 statements), but branch coverage is 62.5% (<70% target) due to unexecuted lines in infra/webhook_client.py (55.6%), api/routes.py (56.0%), and main.py lifespan (67.9%).

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Repository Structure, Supply Chain & Dependencies
audit_dimensions.summary: order-dispatch demonstrates strong repository governance, OpenSSF supply-chain hygiene, and PEP 621 packaging: pyproject.toml separates runtime and dev dependency groups, CI pins GitHub Actions to full 40-char commit SHAs with read-only token permissions, Dependabot monitors uv/docker/github-actions weekly, and Dockerfile runs as non-root UID 10001. Minor gaps exist in uv.lock completeness (missing resolved third-party package pins), Dockerfile pip install bypassing lockfile verification, and README missing test/lint developer commands.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate 12-Factor Config/Statelessness & SRE PRR Timeouts/Observability
audit_dimensions.summary: order-dispatch satisfies 12-Factor and Google SRE Production Readiness baselines: configuration is centralized in ServiceSettings (scattered_env_access=[]), logging uses stdlib loggers (unstructured_logging=[]), outbound webhooks enforce a 5.0s timeout (missing_io_timeouts=[]) with graceful fallback to WEBHOOK_DEFERRED, and /healthz provides readiness probing. For multi-replica production traffic, adding external persistent OrderRepository backing, idempotency keys/bounded webhook retries, and caller authentication/rate-limiting are recommended.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Supply-Chain, CI Permissions, Container & Secret Hygiene
audit_dimensions.summary: Supply-chain, CI permissioning, container hygiene, and secret controls meet OpenSSF Scorecard and OWASP ASVS baselines: CI workflows enforce read-only GITHUB_TOKEN permissions and 40-char SHA-pinned actions, zero secret files are committed, Dependabot covers uv/docker/github-actions, and the container executes under non-root UID 10001. Remaining improvements include adding a container HEALTHCHECK instruction, pinning image digests/lockfile hashes during Docker builds, and implementing the documented OAuth2/JWT authentication TODO on order endpoints.

audit_dimensions.title: Interpret Python AST Facts & Evaluate Quality/Typing/Imports/Security
audit_dimensions.summary: Python AST static analysis confirms 100.0% import hygiene, 100.0% type annotation coverage, 100.0% Google-style docstring coverage, zero circular dependencies, zero complex functions, and zero CWE dangerous code sinks across all 14 modules (435 LOC). Domain logic (models.py, pricing.py) is strictly isolated from FastAPI/httpx frameworks. Primary improvement areas are SEC-05 authentication/authorization enforcement on /v1/orders endpoints and reusing a lifespan-scoped httpx.AsyncClient connection pool in AsyncWebhookClient.

Zero missing I/O timeouts (missing_io_timeouts=[]), zero scattered environment reads (scattered_env_access=[]), and zero unstructured print statements (unstructured_logging=[]).
Graceful degradation pattern: partner webhook timeouts or 5xx responses transition orders to WEBHOOK_DEFERRED instead of failing customer checkout with HTTP 500.
Lightweight GET /healthz probe reports service name, active deployment tier, and liveness status.
All unit tests execute deterministically offline with zero real network calls (_StubWebhookClient in tests/test_dispatcher.py) and zero assertion-free tests.
Domain integer-cents pricing, VIP discount math, and PricingError boundary guards are directly verified in tests/test_pricing.py.
OrderDispatcherService persistence across both DISPATCHED and WEBHOOK_DEFERRED states is verified in tests/test_dispatcher.py.
RV-01 Clean Build: Both examples/python/api_fastapi_clean/Dockerfile (25.03s) and PNI Python 3.12 uv test harness (5.61s) built with exit code 0.
RV-02 Hermetic Offline Tests: 4/4 pytest tests passed in 4.60s with container networking disabled (--network=none).
RV-04 Startup Smoke: FastAPI create_app() and lifespan booted cleanly and returned HTTP 200 on GET /healthz in 2.67s.
100.0% line coverage achieved across services/dispatcher.py, domain/models.py, infra/repository.py, and settings.py.
Zero vulnerabilities (0 CRITICAL, 0 HIGH, 0 MEDIUM, 0 LOW) in all application runtime libraries (fastapi, httpx, pydantic, pydantic-settings, uvicorn).
SEC-03 & SEC-04 Clean: Zero hardcoded or committed secrets across Trivy and AST scans, and zero CWE injection, deserialization, or weak-crypto sinks.
SEC-02 Hardening: 26/27 Trivy Dockerfile checks pass, running as dedicated non-root user appuser (UID 10001) with only 1 LOW informational check (DS-0026 HEALTHCHECK).

SEC-06 Live Mass-Assignment Defense: Dynamic probe test_create_order_forbids_undeclared_mass_assignment_fields confirmed POST /v1/orders rejects undeclared total_cents and is_admin fields with HTTP 422 via Pydantic ConfigDict(extra='forbid').

SEC-06 Live Injection & Surface Resilience: 15/19 live HTTP probes passed with 0 CRITICAL/HIGH findings across reflected XSS, SQLi/stacktrace leakage, path traversal/LFI, untrusted Origin CORS, HTTP TRACE, banner disclosure, and .env/.git exposure.

action_plan.title: Add ASGI HTTP integration tests for FastAPI routes, lifespan, and AsyncWebhookClient
action_plan.action: Exercise GET /healthz, POST /v1/orders (201/422), and GET /v1/orders/{order_id} (200/404) inside 'with TestClient(create_app()) as client:' and test AsyncWebhookClient with httpx.MockTransport.
action_plan.expected_impact: Raises measured line coverage well above the 80% threshold across api/routes.py, main.py, and infra/webhook_client.py.

action_plan.title: Close measured branch/line coverage gaps in routes.py (56.0%), webhook_client.py (55.6%), and main.py (67.9%)
action_plan.action: Add TestClient lifespan integration tests for /healthz, POST /v1/orders, and GET /v1/orders/{order_id} (200 and 404), plus httpx.MockTransport tests for AsyncWebhookClient, plus an invalid vip_discount_rate test for pricing.py:L49.
action_plan.expected_impact: Lifts branch coverage from 62.5% to >90% and brings every module above 90% line coverage.

action_plan.title: Add Idempotency-Key headers and durable OrderRepository adapter option for multi-replica scale
action_plan.action: Include 'Idempotency-Key': record.order_id on outbound webhook requests and allow configuring an external OrderRepository implementation in main.py lifespan.
action_plan.expected_impact: Enables safe horizontal pod autoscaling and duplicate-free partner webhook replay.

action_plan.title: Reuse a lifespan-managed httpx.AsyncClient connection pool in AsyncWebhookClient
action_plan.action: Instantiate a single httpx.AsyncClient within FastAPI lifespan in main.py, pass it to AsyncWebhookClient, and await client.aclose() on shutdown.
action_plan.expected_impact: Eliminates per-request TLS handshake overhead and prevents ephemeral port exhaustion under concurrent order bursts.

action_plan.title: Add container HEALTHCHECK directive and digest-pinned base image in Dockerfile
action_plan.action: Pin python:3.12.6-slim-bookworm by @sha256 digest and add HEALTHCHECK CMD invoking python urllib/httpx against /healthz.
action_plan.expected_impact: Hardens base image immutability and enables automated container orchestrator health recovery.

action_plan.title: Document developer verification commands and complete env var reference in README
action_plan.action: Document 'uv run pytest', 'uv run ruff check src tests', and 'uv run ty check' in README.md alongside ORDER_DISPATCH_VIP_DISCOUNT_RATE and ORDER_DISPATCH_SERVICE_NAME.
action_plan.expected_impact: Improves contributor onboarding and keeps operational documentation synchronized with ServiceSettings.

action_plan.title: Add ASGI security-headers middleware (nosniff) and disable unauthenticated OpenAPI schema in production
action_plan.action: Add an ASGI middleware in src/order_dispatch/main.py setting X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and X-Frame-Options: DENY, and conditionally disable openapi_url/docs_url/redoc_url when settings.env != dev.
action_plan.expected_impact: Resolves live DAST CWE-693 and CWE-200 findings so baseline HTTP hardening and OpenAPI exposure probes pass cleanly.

action_plan.title: Harden ServiceSettings URL and numeric field constraints
action_plan.action: Validate webhook_url as an HTTPS URL and add Field(gt=0.0, le=30.0) on http_timeout_sec and Field(ge=0.0, le=0.5) on vip_discount_rate in ServiceSettings.
action_plan.expected_impact: Catches misconfigured environment variables at startup before runtime requests fail.

summary: order-dispatch (v1.2.0) achieves an Overall Health Score of 89/100 (Grade A). Its Python codebase exemplifies clean 4-layer FastAPI architecture, 100% type/docstring/import hygiene, zero CWE dangerous sinks, zero application library CVEs, and verified offline container test + /healthz smoke readiness, while dynamic containerized penetration testing (web_pentest: 19 probes, 15 passed, 3 failed, 1 skipped, 0 CRITICAL/HIGH) empirically confirmed Pydantic extra='forbid' mass-assignment rejection (HTTP 422) and injection resilience. Prioritized remediations focus on refreshing the python:3.12.6-slim-bookworm base image (P0), enforcing OAuth2/JWT auth on /v1/orders (CWE-306), locking full transitive dependencies in uv.lock, adding ASGI TestClient + MockTransport tests to lift branch coverage above 80% (P1), and adding HTTP security headers (CWE-693) while gating /openapi.json in production (CWE-200, P2).
